App built the PDF (application/pdf 55 KB blob) and mounted a hidden 0x0 iframe with it; the iframe's document is cross-origin to the app in this Chrome-for-Testing build (SecurityError reading its window), and the PDF opened in a NEW TAB in the browser's viewer. Window capture of this context's browser window (shots/7ddfddbf4c8b-browser-window-after-print.png) shows the PDF tab in front with no print dialog. A re-press without the walker's iframe hook (outside recorded steps) also produced a new PDF tab, no error, no notification. MEASUREMENT LIMIT (same as baseline): the harness cannot drive the viewer's print button in the new tab; a human can probably print from there, and whether the app's iframe print() opens a dialog in a regular Chrome is unverified. App-side fact: no print dialog was observed from the in-app control.
